scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('./Frontend/package.json')) { cp.execSync('npm --prefix Frontend install && npm --prefix Frontend run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else if(fs.existsSync('./package.json')) { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
